beetle spot.description: Beetle spots cause brown to black lesions on banana leaves, reducing photosynthesis and yield.
organic_solution: Apply neem oil spray every 7 days
Use pheromone traps to control beetles
chemical_solution: Apply Chlorpyrifos 2 ml per liter if infestation is severe

sigatoka.description: Sigatoka is a fungal disease causing dark streaks and leaf drying in banana plants.
chemical_solution: Alternate with Propiconazole to prevent resistance

panama.description: Panama_Disease is a fungal disease causing dark streaks and leaf drying in banana plants.
chemical_solution: Alternate with Propiconazole to prevent resistance

downy mildew.description: Downy mildew causes yellow patches on leaves and white fungal growth on the underside.
organic_solution: Spray baking soda solution (1 tsp per liter)
